subject: Request: Secure dev artifact payload for SIG review
messages:
From: SIG Assessor <sig-assessor@sigsec.example.com>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: security@finbank.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG - Secure Development artifacts request

Hi Mateo —

Thanks for agreeing to supply artifacts for the Secure Development section of the SIG review. To complete our assessment we need a compact package with the following items (preferably as separate files or a single zip):

- Code review policy and examples demonstrating enforcement (PRs showing reviewer approvals and blocking merges).
- CI/CD job definitions and a recent audit of pipeline runs (last 90 days).
- Evidence of secrets management: key rotation schedule, KMS/HSM usage, and an example of ephemeral credential handling.
- Change management records for production-affecting rollouts (tickets, approvals, post-deploy verification).
- A short mapping table that links the above artifacts to SIG control IDs.

Attached is a template that our tooling uses (sig-request-template-20270530.pdf) to map files to controls; if you can fill that and return by EOD Wed (2027-06-02) that would keep us on the timeline.

If any artifacts contain PII or internal email addresses that need redaction, please flag them and provide an explanation. Also let us know who your technical point-of-contact will be for follow-ups.

Regards,
Maya Singh
SIG Assessment Team
SIG Security Services

From: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, olga.petrov@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SIG - Secure Development artifacts request

Team — forwarding the assessor's checklist. Deadline EOD Wed 6/2. Can we collate a compact package that maps to the SIG template?

Suggested owners: Marissa for code review + change management, Olga for CI/CD + pipeline audit, Neha to oversee secrets artifacts and final redaction. Aditya, could you confirm legal/contract flagging for any DocuSign or licensing notes?

Deliverable guidance: one ZIP with named files and a short index doc that lists which SIG control each file satisfies. Avoid embedding full key material — give logs and proofs, not private keys.

I'll act as the main point-of-contact to the assessor. Please reply with what you can provide today and any blockers.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Mateo / Marissa —

Attached items I can provide immediately:
- pipeline-audit-2027-05-29.csv (export of pipeline runs showing status, duration, triggering user, and artifact hashes).
- sample-jenkinsfile.txt (trimmed Jenkinsfile used by core services; sensitive tokens redacted).
- keystore-rotation-2027-04-12.log (rotation events; contains key IDs and rotation timestamps; secrets have been redacted).

Notes / clarifications:
- Our CI runs are executed on ephemeral build agents in our dedicated pool; secrets are injected from Vault at runtime and never checked into source. The audit CSV shows the job that fetched secrets as "vault-fetch-job" but does not include the values.
- I have redacted a few internal email addresses and user IDs per Neha's guidance; we should include a short redaction log explaining what was stripped and why.

Attachments: pipeline-audit-2027-05-29.csv (csv), keystore-rotation-2027-04-12.log (txt), sample-jenkinsfile.txt (txt)

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior DevOps Engineer
Redwood Inference

Adding the code-review and change-management artifacts we agreed. Summary below; full files attached in the package I uploaded to Drive (link in related_links).

What I am providing:
- pr-sample-PR-4789.diff — example PR showing required reviewer approvals, automated checks (lint, unit tests) passing, and a signed-off-by badge from release lead.
- change-approval-matrix-2027Q2.pdf — matrix linking ticket types to approval gates and owners.
- List of tickets used as evidence: SD-4321, SD-4367, SD-4410 (these include the merge approvals and post-deploy verification checks).

Notes:
- For PR evidence we included one example that touches service code and one hotfix PR for production. We excluded reviewers' personal email addresses per Neha's redaction request; instead the PR diff and metadata show usernames and approval timestamps.
- Change-management artifacts include the Jira workflow screenshots and the post-deploy smoke-test checklist entries.

If the SIG toolchain needs any machine-readable formats (JSON/CSV) for mapping, I can export the PR meta as JSON; otherwise the diff and the matrix should satisfy the control references.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference

Team / Maya —

Thanks everyone — I collected the items into a single package and uploaded to the shared Drive folder (link in related_links). Contents:

1) pipeline-audit-2027-05-29.csv — redacted for PII/internal usernames; column notes included.
2) pr-sample-PR-4789.diff — PR diff and metadata; reviewer usernames present, personal emails removed.
3) keystore-rotation-2027-04-12.log — rotation events with key IDs only.
4) change-approval-matrix-2027Q2.pdf — mapping to SIG controls.
5) sig-mapping-index.txt — short index that lists which file maps to which SIG control ID.

Redaction & attestations:
- All removed fields are enumerated in redaction-log.txt. No secret material (KMS private keys, vault secrets) has been included. Logs show IDs and timestamps only.
- I attest that Vault integrations are configured with dynamic credentials for short-lived database credentials (see Vault role: rw-app-db, TTLs in the pipeline CSV).

Open items:
- Aditya, please confirm if we need a signed attestation on company letterhead for the rotation schedule or whether the redaction log suffices.
- Maya / SIG assessor: let us know if you need PR meta in JSON for automated mapping. We can produce that within 24 hours.

For the external assessor: I am the security owner for this package. Please route any follow-ups to me (neha.kapoor@redwood.ai) and copy Mateo.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Security and Compliance
Redwood Inference
